name: Stormrest
description: A quiet neutron star resting between pulses, with a scarred rock and two comets keeping its time. The beam sweeps on, regular as breathing, disturbing nothing. Rest here is relative, and everyone knows it.

stars.name: Stormrest Calm
stars.description: A rotation-powered remnant between glitches, ticking once per second without variation. Its beams sweep the comets on schedule. Observatories set their clocks by its patience.

planets.name: Restrock
planets.description: An iron world resting in the beam's path, glowing faintly with each sweep. The regularity soothes the instruments if not the crew. Shielded archives below store a century of pulses.

comets.name: Ticktock
comets.description: A long-period comet arriving on the beam's own schedule, or near enough to argue about. Each passage calibrates the long baseline. Its tail keeps perfect time.

comets.name: Second Hand
comets.description: A short-period comet lapping the system every few years like a second hand. Its modest tail brightens the dark on schedule. Children learn to count by its returns.
